scientific_integrity: An unconditional asymptotic proof based on exact connected-type enumeration and a factorial isomorphism-class construction; independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Quantitative inequality is a lower bound, not a sharp asymptotic.
No claim on whether the probability tends to zero.
Uniform individual positions, not uniform isomorphism types.
title: Subexponential collision probability for Pyranim game isomorphism
